Remove Raspberry Pi OS first-boot setup that conflicts with Rugix.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

| Name               | Default  | Description                               |
| ------------------ | -------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `disable_swapfile` | `"true"` | Remove dphys-swapfile. Use true or false. |

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value    |
| ------------ | -------- |
| Priority     | `700000` |
| Dependencies | None     |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Disables the Raspberry Pi OS user-configuration and one-time resize services,
removes userconf-pi, and disables automatic initramfs handling in the boot
configuration. It runs early so subsequent recipes can configure the final
system.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/rpi-raspios-cleanup"]
```
